decisions.authority: Canonical-state, signatures and persistence work may proceed within Phase 4 exit conditions.
decisions.exclusions: No later phase, production-output or release authority is implied.

decisions.decision: Accept the bounded Phase 4 read window.
decisions.authority: Transition-state v1, chair-definition package v1 and bounded B14/B15 read-only ingress are accepted.
decisions.exclusions: Entity-family migration, operator migration, production chairs and production output remain excluded.

decisions.decision: Retire the comparison route from product composition.
decisions.authority: B16 product composition is modular-only; comparison remains development-oracle tooling.
decisions.exclusions: The development oracle, inherited compatibility host and rollback evidence remain; no migration or performance claim is authorised.

decisions.decision: Accept the independent PR-17 recommendation with bounded conditions.
decisions.authority: A separate exact-family support-enablement change was authorised after the disabled tranche.
decisions.exclusions: No operator wiring, whole-document migration, additional family or production output.

decisions.decision: Accept the validated exact-family support window.
decisions.exclusions: Outer detection remains inspection-only; operator wiring, whole-document migration, other families and production output remain excluded.

decisions.decision: Pause product implementation until the project owner resumes it.
decisions.authority: Governance-only housekeeping may proceed under the later explicit instruction.
decisions.exclusions: No further Phase 4 product development is authorised by the housekeeping instruction.

decisions.authority: Use fixed current paths, a dashboard-only plan, frozen history, a governance budget, narrowed true-gate panels and tracked CI.
decisions.exclusions: Historical files are not physically moved in this change; remote CI enforcement and product development remain separate.

decisions.authority: Every task is classified as Level 1 Routine, Level 2 Behavioural or Level 3 Authority/release with proportionate evidence and governance.
decisions.exclusions: The decision does not resume product implementation or add migration, operator, production-output or release authority.

decisions.decision: Require strict app-bound validation on main and close QA-R02.
decisions.authority: Protected main requires the validation check from GitHub Actions app 15368 against the latest base state, with administrator enforcement retained.
decisions.exclusions: No pull-request review count, conversation resolution, linear-history rule, product work, migration support, production output or release authority is added.

decisions.decision: Resume Phase 4 product implementation for the bounded derived-state lifecycle tranche.
decisions.authority: The selected transition slice may add an application-owned, adapter-neutral derived-state signature, invalidation and disposable-regeneration contract.
decisions.exclusions: No renderer choice, operator wiring, Part production geometry, production output, additional migration family or phase exit is authorised.
